best_idea: Pack a frame's sprite quads into one vertex array per atlas and draw them in one call with a per-frame quad cap, and keep best-short-side-fit packing as a load-time tool.
decision_why: Keep the packer and the one-draw batch for client effect layers (decals, sparks, HUD icons); drop repack-on-full from the runtime path and turn rotation off by default, because the donor's rotated fit can store a sprite in a rect whose texels were never turned (D1); client-only, so server kills and the one ledger are untouched.
acceptance: A client unit test packs 500 random sprite sizes into a 2048 atlas and asserts no overlap, every rect inside the atlas, and placed area equal to input area; in a fight with three attackers bleeding, the decal layer shows in one draw call with no sprite stretched or rotated, and the quad cap drops only at the set limit.
